rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an animal's wing.

example.english: The little bird hurt one wing.
example.jyutping: zek3 siu2 niu5 zing2 can1 jat1 bin1 ci3 bong2

rows.note: This is the formal or compound-based choice for an animal wing and for a building or political wing, such as 西翼 or 左翼.

example.english: The west wing of the building is closed today.
example.jyutping: daai6 haa6 sai1 jik6 gam1 jat6 fung1 zo2

rows.note: Use this for a winger or, by extension, the wing position in field sports.

example.english: I play wing for my school team.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 haau6 deoi6 tek3 jik6 fung1

rows.note: Use this specifically for an aircraft wing.

example.english: The aircraft's wing is very large.
example.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 ge3 gei1 jik6 hou2 daai6
